asks.title: Make the quick-start export command executable
asks.requested_behavior: Use the supported --output flag in the quick start, with a copyable CSV example.
asks.how_observed: The documented --out flag failed. Command help showed --output, which worked.
asks.consequence: The first attempt failed and required a help lookup before retrying.
asks.priority_rationale: Fix the broken first attempt before reducing optional friction.
asks.verification: Run the documented command in a fresh workspace; it must produce a 100-row CSV.

measured.basis: sum over referenced events; tokens attributed per whole assistant message (two asks citing events from the same message both carry its tokens); span = first referenced event start to last referenced event end

asks.title: Expose progress while a CSV export is running
asks.requested_behavior: Emit bounded progress on stderr and a final structured completion result.
asks.how_observed: Only start and completion messages appeared during the 47-second export.
asks.consequence: The agent could not distinguish productive work from a stalled command.
asks.priority_rationale: Make long-running work observable without extra polling.
asks.verification: Run a delayed export; progress must remain separate from CSV stdout.

asks.title: Explain when to choose export instead of dump
asks.requested_behavior: State the output formats and intended use of both commands in top-level help.
asks.how_observed: Both commands were described as writing records; the required CSV path was unclear.
asks.consequence: The agent had to choose without a selection signal.
asks.priority_rationale: Remove the ambiguous choice at the start of the task.
asks.verification: A user reading only top-level help can identify the CSV command.
